title: Use Gemini to plan a trip across multiple Google apps
facebook: Ever wish your travel confirmations organized themselves? Gemini can pull your flight and hotel details from Gmail and build a day-by-day itinerary in Google Drive—just ask. Less digging through emails, more time to pack. https://aiworldhq.com/article/plan-a-trip-with-gemini-pull-details-from-gmail-into-google-drive
